messages:
Ana (AE): Heads up — Acme Legal returned the MSA + DPA with ~4 redlines. They want the DPA signed before we start the POC, bump SLA to 99.95%, and require invoicing via PO. Order form ref: OF-2026-349. Can legal/procurement advise on next steps?

Raj (SE): POC environment is ready in staging (can be eu-west). Timeline is ~2 weeks. If DPA signing is required pre-POC that adds ~2-3 days to schedule. We can restrict POC data to anonymized/eph resources.

Jules (Procurement): For PO-based invoicing we need a signed order form + billing contact. Who signs first on the DocuSign route? Also need the exact PO language they want.

Matt (Legal): Quick read: SLA -> 99.95 is a material change. Propose we counter with 99.9% and a service credit cap (e.g., 10% monthly cap). DPA pre-POC is OK if we narrow scope (only POC data, no prod data) and include deletion/retention limits (30d). I'll prepare counter-redlines and track changes. Ping @Sophie for outstanding security items.

Sophie (Security): Open items in their security questionnaire: 1) SOC2 attestation copy; 2) up-to-date subprocessor list; 3) clarity on encryption at rest keys. We can share SOC2 and subprocessors. For the DPA add Appendix listing subprocessors + SCCs. Also confirm POC will use ephemeral keys (we do) and EU residency if they require it.

Ana (AE): Customer insists EU data residency for the POC. Can infra spin eu-west?

Raj (SE): Yes, eu-west staging available. Need project ID and contact to attach. For POC we'll enable tokenization + redaction.

Jules (Procurement): On payment terms: customer requests net45 + PO number up front. Our billing prefers net30. Can we accept net45 for an enterprise POC? Also routing: AE signs first, then customer legal, then Redwood legal? Confirm.

Clara (Finance): FYI — Finance will accept net45 on deals >= $50k ARR. What is the expected order value for this POC?

Ana (AE): POC is free (evaluation), order form is nominal to capture scope — no charge for trial. They still want the form signed to issues a PO.

Matt (Legal): If the POC has no charges, we should avoid payment terms that obligate Redwood. Recommend the order form be labeled "Trial Order Form — No Charges" and that any PO only applies to subsequent commercial order. I'll prepare language to decouple PO/payment obligations.

signature-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.example/ENVELOPE-ACME-2026 (routing: Ana (AE) -> Acme Legal -> Matt (Legal)).

Ana (AE): Thanks — I'll wait for Matt's redlines then upload into DocuSign and route. Raj — can you create project ID and share creds via 1Password?

Raj (SE): Done. Staging project ID: ACME-POC-21. Walkthrough/runbook uploaded to the shared drive.

Matt (Legal): Uploaded counter-redlines to the drive. Proposed compromise: SLA 99.9%, credit cap 10%, DPA narrow scope + 30d deletion, trial order form with "no charges" clause. If Finance confirms net45 despite zero charges we can leave PO field optional.

Jules (Procurement): I'll coordinate with the customer on PO numbering and with finance for net45 approval if needed.

Ana (AE): Great — I'll push customer to accept the trial-order approach to avoid payment/legal hold ups. Setting reminder for EOD tomorrow to check signatures. :thumbsup:

signature-bot: DocuSign status: envelope sent to first signer (Ana).
